modules.name: Bleet
modules.summary: Observable session and transcript state with incremental live metrics.
modules.security: No transport or tool execution; streamed display state is coalesced by Shepherd.
modules.validation: BleetTests covers message revisions and live metrics; the Bleet test plan covers composer, transcript and status presentation. Run `make test MODULE=Bleet`.

modules.name: Caprine
modules.summary: Themes, colour rendering and reusable visual primitives.
modules.security: Theme files are bounded local data; font declarations never download assets.
modules.validation: CaprineTests covers theme catalogues, storage security and font persistence; hosted Caprine tests cover appearance and font rendering. Run `make test MODULE=Caprine`.

modules.name: goat
modules.security: Connects only to the private local socket; the running app owns persistence and approvals.

modules.name: GOATed
modules.summary: Scoped extension capabilities, registration lifetimes, skills and declarative .goated packages.
modules.security: Bundled native code remains trusted; handles are scoped, revocable and bounded. User archives are validated in memory without extraction or execution.
modules.validation: GOATedTests (including package admission and scope), AppToolRouterTests and UserExtensionTests. Run `make test MODULE=GOATed`.

modules.name: Herd
modules.summary: Local home, credentials, attachment files and user workspace bindings.
modules.interfaces: Home, LocalFileStore, CredentialStore, AttachmentStore, HerdWorkspaceFileWorker, GitWorkspaceWorker
modules.security: Owner-only credentials and bounded filesystem reads; Git probes stay local and initialization is explicit.
modules.validation: HerdTests covers credentials, bounded filesystem reads and attachments; hosted Herd tests cover workspaces and image preparation. Run `make test MODULE=Herd`.

modules.name: Hindsight
modules.summary: Optional bank-scoped memory service transport and store.
modules.security: Uses JUDAS and the bounded MCP adapter; bank authority and response limits are explicit. No automatic cross-Pen migration.
modules.validation: The Hindsight test plan covers provider contracts, bounded responses, browsing and session ownership. Run `make test MODULE=Hindsight`.

modules.name: Hitch
modules.summary: Same-user local control API, replay ledger and Unix socket.
modules.security: Off by default; private Unix socket, no TCP, no credentials API, no approval bypass.
modules.validation: HitchTests includes real temporary sockets and the built CLI. Run `make test MODULE=Hitch`.

modules.name: Hoofprint
modules.summary: Bounded activity history, event-driven audit publication and local rendering signposts.
modules.security: Bounded to 500 in-memory entries; no durable telemetry or endpoint.
modules.validation: JudasActivityTests; rendering and Shepherd host tests. Run `make test MODULE=Hoofprint`.

modules.name: Inference
modules.summary: Engine contracts, capability discovery, prompt budgets and streaming.
modules.security: Configured endpoints through JUDAS; context is data, never permission; no in-process ML.
modules.validation: InferenceTests covers wire handling, budgets, capabilities and lifecycle ownership. Run `make test MODULE=Inference`.

modules.name: JUDAS
modules.summary: Host connection policy, revocation and bounded security events.
modules.security: Configured / local-networks-only / blocked policy; redirects rejected. Not an OS firewall or native-code sandbox.
modules.validation: JudasTests, JudasMCPTests, JudasActivityTests and the network boundary checker. Run `make test MODULE=JUDAS`.

modules.name: MCPClient
modules.summary: MCP server configuration, transport and capability-bound invocation.
modules.security: Only module importing the external MCP SDK. JUDAS admits transports/processes; app approvals bind to configuration identity.
modules.validation: MCPClientTests and MCPModelSecurityTests. Run `make test MODULE=MCPClient`.

modules.name: Memory
modules.summary: Provider-neutral memory contracts, scope and local stores.
modules.security: Exclusive Global or Pen scope, bounded descriptor-relative filesystem operations; provider content does not grant authority.
modules.validation: MemoryTests and MemoryModelTests. Run `make test MODULE=Memory`.

modules.name: Paddock
modules.summary: Artifact values, HTML shells, navigation policy and WebKit host.
modules.security: Bounded in-memory document preparation; ephemeral WebKit, shared immutable rules, Source-mode document retirement and JUDAS revocation.
modules.validation: The Paddock test plan covers navigation, rendering, document and rule-cache contracts. Repeated timing workloads are in Qualification. Run `make test MODULE=Paddock`.

modules.name: Pens
modules.summary: Folder-backed Pen metadata, instructions and serializable colour. Native workspace file operations support the bundled GOATed Herder extension.
modules.interfaces: PenSpec, PenStore, PenFileRef, OKLCH, PenFileTools, PenCommandTools
modules.security: Validated identifiers, staged writes, explicit workspace binding; no UI framework or database dependency. File tools use a turn-bound workspace and descriptor-relative traversal, reject symlinks and multiple hard links, bound reads, and require host approval before writes. Commands use a deny-default macOS sandbox, isolated environment, separate owner whitelist and JUDAS network admission.
modules.validation: PensTests covers stores and file/command tools; hosted Pens tests cover permission grants and project navigation. Run `make test MODULE=Pens`.

modules.name: Persistence
modules.summary: Chat database, migrations, records and tool-grant storage.
modules.interfaces: ChatDatabase, ChatRecord, MessageRecord, ToolGrantRecord, PenFileGrantRecord, ToolEventSnapshot
modules.security: Async GRDB pool with indexed reads; cached narrow checkpoints preserve independent metadata. Durable records never depend on render caches.
modules.validation: DatabaseTests and PersistenceWriterTests. Run `make test MODULE=Persistence`.

modules.name: Pronk
modules.summary: The offline, Pen-scoped fictional-goat extension example.
modules.security: Bundled example using public GOATed contracts; state stays in the selected Pen scope; no network or scripts.
modules.validation: PronkTests exercises offline persistence and Pen scope; examples/pronk documents usage. Run `make test MODULE=Pronk`.

modules.name: Shepherd
modules.summary: Single-turn orchestration, worker execution, tool rounds and durable handover.
modules.security: One active turn for GUI and Hitch; persistence and capability checks gate progress. Worker I/O stays off MainActor.
modules.validation: ShepherdModelTests and turn-ownership host tests. Run `make test MODULE=Shepherd`.

modules.name: Tools
modules.summary: Transport-neutral tool discovery, requests and results.
modules.security: Contracts carry data only; no transport, database, UI or authority implementation.
modules.validation: GOATed, MCPClient and host router contract tests.

planned.name: Tether
planned.summary: Media drafts and contextual Image/Video controls. Separate media engine and job coordination, proposed in ADR-0029.
